interpretation: Evaluation under static zero-point specialization; no extrapolation to ZR and no proven upper bound on D's advantage.

zero_point_profiles.rationale: Preserve the protocol's three separate controls: removable correction, power-of-two correction, and the upper U4 endpoint. These are not population frequencies.

Use z[r,g]=(phase+row_stride*r+group_stride*g) modulo 16. All phases give equal frequency to every U4 code at each shape/seed. Coprime strides cover rows/groups without random imbalance; the initial K=G has only one group. This synthetic schedule is not a model-derived distribution.

reporting.mixed_zs_runs: Report full-kernel metrics with the effective z histogram; never apportion cycles to strata by frequency.
